{{Top}}
The '''Mumuu''' were a [[Species/Legends|species]] of large, tusked beast native to the [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kalee/Legends|Kalee]]. They were renowned for their thick hides, extraordinary backbone and possession of two [[Heart/Legends|hearts]]. [[Kaleesh/Legends|Kaleesh]] would slay them with [[Shoni spear]]s. This pastime eventually evolved into [[mumuu-fighting]] and became a popular spectator sport among the Kaleesh. During artistic displays, Kaleesh matadors use the [[Lig sword]]'s pointed tip to penetrate its extremely hard backbone to pierce a mumuu's two hearts. The Mumuu also were prized for their meat, and they had very high immune systems due to their second heart, similar to [[Cerean/Legends|Cereans]]. They were able to be domesticated by the Kaleesh, but often not for long.<ref name="Lord of War">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/member/insideronline/86/indexp2.html|text=The Story of General Grievous: Lord of War|int=The Story of General Grievous: Lord of War}}</ref>

[[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]]'s [[Helmet|mask]], which protected his face, was based on a mumuu [[Bone/Legends|skull]] he once wore. The [[Cloak/Legends|cloaks]] of [[IG-100 MagnaGuard/Legends|IG-100 MagnaGuards]] also sported Mumuu inspired markings.<ref name="CharEnc">''[[Star Wars Character Encyclopedia]]''</ref>
